zh.title: 连接你家里的 Lomorage
zh.description: 在手机上安装 LomoMobile，然后连接你电脑上的 Lomorage。
zh.heading: 先在手机上装好 LomoMobile
zh.intro: 你刚刚扫描的是电脑上的 Lomorage 设置码。要连接它，需要先安装 LomoMobile 应用。
zh.wechat: 微信里无法下载应用。请点右上角「···」，选择「在浏览器中打开」。
zh.installText: 免费下载，安装完成后回到这里继续。
zh.scanTitle: 回到电脑，用应用再扫一次
zh.scanText: 打开 LomoMobile，点「扫码」，对准电脑屏幕上的同一个二维码。
zh.manualText: 在应用的连接页面输入下面这个地址：
zh.installedNote: 已经装好应用？直接打开 LomoMobile 扫码即可。

en.title: Connect to your Lomorage
en.description: Install LomoMobile on your phone, then connect it to Lomorage on your computer.
en.heading: First, get LomoMobile on this phone
en.intro: You just scanned the Lomorage setup code on your computer. To connect, install the LomoMobile app first.
en.wechat: Apps can’t be downloaded inside WeChat. Tap “···” in the top-right corner and choose “Open in browser”.
en.installText: It’s free. Come back here when it’s installed.
en.scanTitle: Scan the code again from the app
en.scanText: Open LomoMobile, tap “Scan”, and point it at the same QR code on your computer screen.
en.manualTitle: Scanning not working? Type the address
en.manualText: Enter this address on the app’s connect screen:
en.installedNote: Already have the app? Just open LomoMobile and scan.
